notes: Blindness limitation: the initial general primary-paper web search inadvertently returned FORRT-domain search snippets. No FORRT page was opened. Statistics below were taken only from author-provided primary paper text. Both papers and Study 1 verified. The supplied description does not specify the contrast. Congruency main-effect statistics are recorded as explicitly labelled candidates, with target_match null; these are NOT verified target extractions. Original p. 4 additionally reports the number-by-congruency interaction and a different-movements versus no-movement comparison. Replication Experiment 1 never presented two different movements simultaneously, so it cannot match that latter contrast. No values were converted.
